verdict.rationale: Deep Research lets Gemini run in-depth research across Search, Gmail, Drive and uploaded files, and Scheduled Actions run recurring tasks on a daily, weekly or monthly cadence. Together these suggest delegated, unattended work, but the docs cover them only in single lines. Neither is described as a general-purpose autonomous multi-step agent with a review or approval step before results are accepted. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of background or asynchronous execution, general multi-step task delegation beyond research and recurring digests, a review/approval workflow for returned results, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
